title: Obesity as a Mediator in the Association Between Urinary Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbon Exposure and Liver Fibrosis Risk in US Adults
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00050E, Paper
Wang Guo, Beizhu Ye, Xiaoli Ma, Jinying Liu, Yanqin Yue, Xingyuan Yang, Jian Hou, Xiuling Li, Xiaoying Luo
Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) exposure may be associated with obesity-mediated liver injury. However, there is lacking evidence on the role of obesity in associations of PAHs exposure with liver fibrosis...
